title: Door thresholds with a 20 mm change in level for a proposed school gymnasium
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE Chief Executive determination; Building Act 2004; comparative only, not Alberta)
code_edition: Not stated in the extracted text; D1/AS1, C/AS4 and E2/AS1 cited; edition of the acceptable solutions not stated

facts.text: The proposed work is a learning centre and a gymnasium in a school; the gymnasium is used for sports and assemblies and includes a cafe, a food-technology room, changing rooms and a music room.
The designer proposed level thresholds under canopies and a threshold with a 20 mm change in level between external and internal surfaces for three gymnasium doors facing southwest and southeast.

Figure 1 is a site plan (p.2); Figure 2 is the door threshold detail (p.3); Figure 3 (p.9) is a sketch of a stepped threshold as a change in level; the decision compares the proposed detail with the design shown in Figure 17B of the Acceptable Solution (p.10).

facts.text: The detail is assessed against D1/AS1, C/AS4 and E2/AS1, and the terms stepped threshold, weather stop and isolated step are discussed.
